tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
F="tests/test_narration_corpus.py"
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 4 $F 2>&1 | tail -4
n=$(.venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 $F 2>&1 | grep -c "test_golden_ok_entries_remain_accepted\[" || true)
[ "$n" = "9" ] || { echo "expected 9 collected golden cases, got $n"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python -m ruff check $F
.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $F
git add -A -- tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -v -x -e tests/test_narration_corpus.py || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
git diff --cached --binary > /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/corpus-by-scene/corpus.patch
test -s /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/corpus-by-scene/corpus.patch
